name: Eisengießerei Velkenreith GmbH

quality.trend: OTD falling for a year (89.6 % 2025Q4 -> 74.5 %), amber two quarters running

payment_behaviour.note: avg 50.9 days on 45 net; 4.8 days late in last 12m; no complaint about it on file

financial_health.signal: solid; VDA 6.3 grade A; no distress signal in notes

notes: 310030 settled below full cost three times ('to keep the volume')
310031 (sole source) settled 0.0 % on asks of +2.0 and +3.2 %

situation: Healthy family iron foundry, 70 % of HN 200 impellers and sole source for HN 250. 310030 is priced about 5 % under its own should-cost (cost:310030) while Kalwisz delivers the same part at 30.14, so there is little price room. Delivery is the weak spot: OTD down to 74.5 %. The framework expires 2026-12-31, and Velkenreith is invited to the HX 80-200 volute RFQ (P06) against Tarsevi, which is new work it will want.

pressures.evidence: competes for HX 80-200 volute casing (4,200 pc/yr) against Tarsevi

what_it_values: new HX business and continuity of HN volume

likely_tradeables.get: committed lead time at or below 49 days with OTD plan

likely_tradeables.give: pay on time at 45 (we average 5.9 days late)

arguments_that_should_land.argument: Rolling OTD is 74.5 % against a 95 % target, amber two quarters in a row.
arguments_that_should_land.why: factual, its own weak spot; justifies asking for a delivery commitment rather than a cut

arguments_that_should_land.argument: HN 200 impeller is benchmarked at 30.14 at our second source (quote 32.90 in 2025).
In the HX RFQ a low-cost bidder with idle capacity is also quoting.

arguments_to_avoid.why: already ~5 % under its own should-cost; stabilise goal
no qualified alternative exists for HN 250
industrial power is -3.7 % yoy but spot power/gas rose sharply; low payoff

persona.who_writes: inside sales (new contact since 2025-10), owner in the background
persona.relationship_notes: owner reminds us he held prices in 2022 and expects partnership
